description: Itesoti ni Nilotic e’yo, ba a’yo Uganda ngaa vu, Soroti, Kumi, Serere ka Amuria alia, ka Kenya alia.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Lugbara courses (#132) with low confidence in Lugbara; needs a native-speaker review. Word and unit notes fall back to the English notes about the target language.

why.title: E’yo **Soroti, Kumi ka Teso ideyi ni.**
why.text: Itesoti ovu Karimojongti ka Turkanati ndi, Ateker suru alia. Imba aku ba ni, geri ndizu ni, azi ni, ka ongo ka e’yo ati Teso ni.

cards.title: Aku ba ni
cards.text: A’yo atibi ka aku bayi be Soroti ka Kumi alia.

cards.title: Ba ndi geri dria ni
cards.text: Ndi Soroti ni ani Kumi, Ngora ka ide Bisina.

cards.title: Ba le e’yo ni ni
cards.text: Ndre Nilotic e’yo, rui ovu be oku ka agupi ni.

landing.audience: Ba Lugbarati a’yo ni etozu ni, aku bayi emu Teso ni, ka ba ndi Soroti.
landing.first: Ngoni, ru a’yozu ka nde, vutia aku ba, nyaka, suku, sawa, vu, jo ka ruakini, alu alu.

cast.emma: Uji imba Itesoti ndi geri dria ndraa
